source_fact: run_thf_engine_sgp.sh execs python -m veteran_desk.engine_supervisor. That module is not in this repository. The unit MainPID is the supervisor. vd_engine is its child. A fresh supervisor PID does not prove book.py or gate_v2.py was imported.
do_not: kill -s KILL any of these pids
stop or restart the tick timer
why_restart_is_unsafe: KillMode=control-group does not include the user session. Another unit restart replaces 1940860 and still leaves 833092 holding 1941386. The new official supervisor sees that daemon and does not spawn.
stops: The tick owns stops. Leave tfo-thf-tick.timer running. Firm-risk PID 337359 is exec_speed risk-serve and stays up.
handover: HANDOVER.json is the census at 20:24:20 WITA. The only later signal is kill -s TERM 833092, and only after the live recheck in that file. No SIGKILL, no unit restart, no manual daemon.
